newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli forces remove Jews from Hebron casbah.
newsitem.headline: Israeli forces remove Jews from Hebron casbah.

text.p: Israeli troops removed Jewish settlers from two homes they seized in the Arab casbah of Hebron early on Wednesday in protest at government plans to hand over much of the West Bank town to Palestinians.

Witnesses said soldiers and police removed the settlers from the casbah, even chasing settler women and children across rooftops. The few settlers who remained were expected to leave soon, the witnesses said.
Witnesses said at least two girls and a man were arrested when they refused to leave.

Some 20 Jews broke into the vacant houses only a day after Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyanu and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat made progress on a long-overdue Israeli handover of much of the West Bank town to Palestinian self-rule.

Under a 1995 peace deal, Israel is to give Palestinians control of 80 percent of Hebron, holy to both Jews and Moslems as the burial place of the biblical Abraham. The 400 settlers who live in the heart of the town of 100,000 Arabs fear the deal will endanger their security. Israel captured the town with the rest of the West Bank in the 1967 Middle East war.

The settlers claimed one house was Jewish property and the other a building they feared the PLO would use to house guerrillas. The Arab casbah is in the 20 percent of Hebron due to remain under Israeli occupation in the deal along with the Jewish enclaves.
